description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Haloyawaththa, Janapadaya, Doluwa D/S Division, Kandy District - (25/0048)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, locations, extents, and ownership details (The State and Land Reforms Commission). The content falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
